title: The Gap Can Make You Cry (Out)
excerpt: The gap between the church’s potential and actual impact can make you cry. But far better: the gap can make you cry out, determined to see the church fulfill its potential. – The Great Spiritual Migration (available NOW, 2016) Tour info here: /archive
